en: An old black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing three photographs of the same or related villas/buildings with neoclassical details, verandas, and pitched roofs. Above the images is the title "Villa Nicu N. Albu, Piatra‑N." On the left margin, printed vertically, is the publisher credit. The overall layout and typography resemble early 20th‑century European postcards.
